first-demo-registry-handoff-on-preprod.text: First demo: registry handoff on preprod.

As a Cardano KERI integrator, I want to see a released Singular registry handle a real identity's registration, retirement and custody, so that I can evaluate the interface that Cardano KERI will consume.

Where this stands (October 2026). The registry half of this play, called Demo 1, can be played today on a private test chain: the Demo 1 page says what it shows and links the steps to play. The play below, which joins a kli identity and ckeri, is the later integration. It was planned before Demo 1 was cut, so its dates and its release tag are plans, not results: Demo 1 ships in the 0.x series, and the v1.0.0 tag this page once named is not the tag Demo 1 uses.

8 October 2026 was a target, not an observed result. The project story requires a connected Cardano preprod play. The accepted Singular Lean model defines expected transitions; the deployed script, released operator command and fresh node readbacks must establish each claimed outcome.

The planned identity read path is the Cardano KERI follower store: use ckeri writes with --store PATH and status with explicit --backend local --store PATH, recording its chain point and freshness. The Singular registry readback needs the persistent indexed proof path tracked by #107; the current ordinary Koios path provides raw outputs and history in Unbound sessions with Unverified facts, without that accepted persistent proof path. The older Koios-backed V1 cast is a checkpoint baseline only; it cannot stand in for this joined result.

preprod-play-to-record.text: The registry operation names above describe the user story. They are not asserted to be commands available in the current release. The registry epic #154 must supply the released Singular interface and connected preprod receipts. The Cardano KERI consumer mapping #324 must bind the two accepted models before the joined sequence is an accepted integration.

recording-gate.text: Record an asciicast only after the exact kli, ckeri and Singular preprod commands complete. The cast must show their real output, transaction IDs, script and policy identities and fresh readbacks. A fictional name may label a freshly generated identity or asset, but its actual identifiers and ledger effects must come from the run. No preprod cast is attached yet.
